pages.text: $(li)The best way into AE2 is a Storage Bus directly on an EMC Link (see AE2 and Cell Storage). The Basic EMC Link doesn't accept or output items.

$(li)An EMC loop: ME IO Port with 3 Hyper Acceleration Cards, connected to an ME Storage Bus on an EMC Link.$(li)Use ME Interfaces for non-EMC resources and EMC Links for EMC-based ones when feeding passive automation.
$(li)To hold a target stock of an EMC item, put a Storage Bus on a Dank or Drawer with upgrades to set thresholds.
